post.description: Rotates the session using the refreshToken cookie and issues new access/refresh tokens as httpOnly cookies. Each refresh token can be consumed only once, including concurrent requests. Returns 401 if the cookie is missing; returns 400 if the token is invalid, expired or already consumed. A rejected refresh does not set or clear session cookies. Access JWTs include the current session version. Legacy access tokens without a version are rejected by authenticated routes; an unexpired, unrevoked refresh token can still renew the session. A refresh using a token revoked by logout or reset fails.
